task: Read-only review of target-lux draft/apply flow, inverse bounds, stale light identity, and rejection without scene/history mutation

findings.title: Exactly reachable maximum output is rejected when adjusting from a lower intensity
findings.description: The inverse quotient can round slightly above 100000 cd even when the requested lux is the exact forward-model output of a valid 100000 cd light. The fallback only accepts an unchanged source setting, so a 400 cd source cannot reach this valid boundary through Set ideal lux.

reproduction.expected: 100000 cd because its valid forward-model illuminance equals the target exactly

findings.recommendation: On an out-of-range quotient, separately test the 100000 cd boundary and accept it only when its forward-model lux exactly matches the target; add a lower-source-to-maximum regression while preserving rejection of genuinely unattainable targets.
